# #

## Description

Description

The route section of a Gaussian job is initiated by a pound sign (#) as the first non-blank character of a line. The remainder of the section is in free-field format.

## Alternate Forms

Alternate Forms

#### #N

Normal print level; this is the default.

#### #P

Additional output is generated.

#### #T

Terse output.

## Other

Other section.

#### #Z

Not an alternate form entry.
